headline: Advance Reservations for the Getty Center and Griffith Planetarium
reservation: While entry to the Getty Center is complimentary, timed entry reservations are essential and must be secured via the official museum portal. Griffith Observatory is free to enter, but tickets for Samuel Oschin Planetarium shows are sold only on-site and frequently sell out. Always verify the latest reservation protocols via official agency websites as systems for high-traffic landmarks are subject to change.

stops.name: Griffith Observatory

intel.title: Urban Lot Management
intel.text: Utilize official structures at the Getty and Hollywood & Highland to avoid restricted residential zones. Public lots in Santa Monica use tiered pricing; check posted signs for maximum stay limits.

intel.title: Canyon Connectivity
intel.text: Expect intermittent cellular service while hiking the Santa Monica Mountains or Topanga Canyon trails. Download offline navigation maps before departing urban hubs like Beverly Hills.

intel.title: Supply Routing
intel.text: Standard stations are plentiful throughout the LA Basin, though prices vary by neighborhood. Ensure tanks are sufficient before entering the winding stretches of the Pacific Coast Highway north of Malibu.

intel.title: The Commuter Factor
intel.text: Arrivals at high-draw sites like the Observatory are best timed for weekday mornings to avoid weekend surges. Late afternoon travel between Santa Monica and DTLA can double expected transit times.

intel.title: Public Transit Links
intel.text: The Metro rail system connects Pasadena and Long Beach to the city core, bypassing freeway congestion. Local DASH buses provide circuit service in Hollywood and Downtown for shorter transfers.

plan.arrival: Collect rental at LAX and transit to Santa Monica or West Hollywood for supply stops and hotel check-in.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are ideal for city parking; check rental restrictions for unpaved canyon roads.
plan.goldenHour: Point Dume State Beach offers coastal sunset views; accessibility depends on seasonal gate closures.
